verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own trigger docs list a native "Schedule" trigger for workflows, and a community thread cites a cron execution limit. That indicates recurring scheduled runs are a first-party capability. The evidence is only a bare list item, though, with no documentation of how schedules are defined or managed, and the cron limits come from an old community post. missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, timezones), programmatic or AI/agent-driven schedule creation via API/CLI, current execution limits for scheduled runs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
